title: Crypto Industry Files Complaint Against Australia’s ABC Over Bitcoin Article
summary: Australia's Bitcoin Industry Body escalates tensions with public broadcaster ABC over coverage it alleges misrepresented Bitcoin as purely criminal, coinciding with the country's 31% crypto adoption rate and comprehensive regulatory framework introduction. title: Swiss Inflation Unexpectedly Slows to Zero in SNB Setback
summary: Swiss inflation unexpectedly stalled in November and an underlying measure slowed to a four-year low, a setback for central bank officials just days before their final interest-rate decision of 2025.
